title: Tracybot: Preserving Developer Intent by Tracing Agent-Generated Code to Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2611.09395v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are now widely used in software development, and LLM-based coding agents are given increasing autonomy. With coding agents, many design decisions are made in the conversation between the developer and the agent. Typically, the developer starts a conversation with an agent and states their intent, the agent proposes options if needed, and the developer plans the change accordingly. Then, the resulting code is committed. However, in such scenarios, the decisions and the intent behind the changes remain in the conversation, with no link to the code they produced. In this paper, we present Tracybot, an open-source tool that integrates with VS Code, Git, and coding agents to keep track of relevant conversations in an LLM-assisted development process. Tracybot captures each change as a Tasklet which consists of optional planning prompts used to plan a change, together with a build prompt that produces it. Tracybot

translated_title: Tracybot：通过将智能体生成的代码追溯至提示词来保留开发者意图
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）目前已被广泛应用于软件开发领域，基于LLM的编码智能体正被赋予越来越多的自主权。在使用编码智能体时，许多设计决策都是在开发者与智能体的对话中做出的。通常，开发者会与智能体开启对话并陈述其意图，智能体在需要时提出可选方案，开发者据此规划变更，随后生成的代码被提交。然而，在这样的场景中，决策以及变更背后的意图仅留存于对话之中，与其所生成的代码之间没有任何关联。本文提出了Tracybot，这是一个开源工具，它与VS Code、Git以及编码智能体相集成，用于在LLM辅助的开发过程中追踪相关对话。Tracybot将每次变更捕获为一个Tasklet（小任务单元），其中包含用于规划变更的可选规划提示词，以及生成该变更的构建提示词。Tracybot
tldr: Tracybot是一个与VS Code、Git和编码智能体集成的开源工具，它将每次代码变更以Tasklet的形式与其对应的规划和构建提示词关联起来，从而追踪并保留LLM辅助开发过程中对话所承载的开发者意图。
en_tdlr: Tracybot is an open-source tool that integrates with VS Code, Git, and coding agents to preserve developer intent by capturing each code change as a Tasklet that links the generated code back to its planning and build prompts.
